> *Note:*  
> - There were **56 total signatures**, representing representatives from each of the thirteen original colonies.  
> - Some signers had previously opposed independence but later changed their stance after deliberation.  
> - The most famous signature—on the very first page—is that of **John Hancock**, whose bold writing earned him lasting fame.  

If you’d like more details about any particular signer’s background or role in early American history, feel free to ask!
